summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything, per the instructions. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar in src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py now takes clickable_ranges (before width), yields one Text, and appends click spans last; Opacity in src/textual/renderables/opacity.py merges the blended color into the existing style so meta is preserved; tests added to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (existing tests untouched) and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with __init__.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css. Nothing was committed. Not verified by running: the test suite and a live app. Choices to review: the resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already has min_size defaulting to 1; the bar position uses the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list index, which differs only when duplicate names precede the active one; letter search only fires for single-character keys; on_key overrides Widget.on_key, so key_* dispatch is skipped; a label with zero cell width becomes a flexible edge.
